evidence.claim: In 1996 the Neon Museum began reinstalling old signs downtown to attract visitors.
evidence.quote: On September 18, 1996, the Las Vegas City Council voted to fund such a project, to be known as The Neon Museum. The organization started out by re-installing old signage in downtown Las Vegas, to attract more visitors to the area.

evidence.claim: William Bringhurst’s Mormon missionaries chose a site beside a creek flowing from Las Vegas Springs for their fort in 1855.
evidence.quote: Mormon missionaries led by William Bringhurst arrived on June 14, 1855, and selected a site, along one of the creeks that flowed from the Las Vegas Springs, on which they would build the fort.

evidence.claim: William Bringhurst’s Mormon missionaries chose a site beside a creek flowing from Las Vegas Springs for their fort in 1855.
evidence.quote: It contains the Old Mormon Fort (completed 1855)

evidence.claim: It served as a midpoint on the trail between Salt Lake City and Los Angeles.
evidence.quote: The fort served as the midpoint on the trail between Salt Lake City, Utah and Los Angeles, California.

evidence.claim: The missionaries abandoned it with the beginning of the Utah War.
evidence.quote: As a result of the beginning of the Utah War, the Mormons abandoned the fort.

evidence.claim: Octavius Gass reoccupied it in 1865 and began irrigation works, naming the property Los Vegas Rancho.
evidence.quote: In 1865, Octavius Gass re-occupied the fort and started the irrigation works, renaming the area to Los Vegas Rancho

evidence.claim: Ownership changed repeatedly, and the fort came close to destruction several times.
evidence.quote: Ownership of the fort and the land around it changed hands many times and it had several close calls with destruction.

evidence.claim: The city acquired the fort in 1989 with support from the Daughters of Utah Pioneers; state protection followed in 1991.
evidence.quote: With support of the Daughters of Utah Pioneers, the city of Las Vegas acquired the fort in 1989. Long-term protection was gained when the state acquired the site as a state park in 1991.

evidence.claim: A visitor center explains this history.
evidence.quote: A visitor center explains the history of the fort.
